newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate rises to 5.82 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate rises to 5.82 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills rose to 5.82 percent from 5.79 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Tuesday.
The average price fell to 98.550 from 98.557 and the minimum price accepted was 98.544.
Banks submitted bids for 16.55 million dinars worth of bills, down from 21.57 million dinars the previous week.
The bills, maturing on July 23, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
